fixture: 60 stage-1 troops: all five classes and three lines, four identical mixed squads; same formation and both-side actual AI. Normalized mode fixes both general profiles to neutral-line Assassin (Human/M) and swaps ONLY specials. Native mode preserves general profiles. No campaign/evolution/economy inference.

special.name: Holy Rally
special.description: A pillar of light washes over your whole army: every ally heals and takes less damage for a while.

special.name: Arrow Storm
special.description: A sky-darkening volley rains on 30 enemy troops anywhere on the field.

special.name: Shadow Mark
special.description: Shadows strike the enemy general directly and cut down a dozen of their troops.

special.name: Dragon Breath
special.description: A river of fire roars across the whole battlefield toward the enemy general, burning everything in its path.

special.name: Tempest Dive
special.description: A storm of talons strikes 25 enemies and leaves the whole enemy army slowed.

special.name: Pack Howl
special.description: A howl drives your entire army into a frenzy: faster and harder-hitting.

special.name: Meteor Fall
special.description: Meteors fall across the entire field, striking every enemy troop and their general.

special.name: Hellfire Wave
special.description: A wall of hellfire surges across the battlefield and through the enemy general.

special.name: Sanctuary
special.description: A holy seal covers the whole army: allies heal and are shielded from harm.

special.name: Inferno
special.description: The whole field ignites: every enemy is scorched and keeps burning.

special.name: Guiding Light
special.description: A gentle light restores your army and quickens its steps.

special.name: Judgement
special.description: A sweeping column of holy fire crosses the field and strikes the enemy general.

special.name: Plague Cloud
special.description: A plague settles over the enemy army: they rot over time and strike weakly.

special.name: Earthquake
special.description: The ground splits under the whole enemy army, wounding and staggering every troop.

special.name: Overclock
special.description: Your army surges with power: faster, stronger and sturdier for a time.
